summaries.tprm: Implementation Engineer, TPRM with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in REST API integrations, Python and Node.js scripting, workflow automation, and GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, NIST, PCI DSS). Built and owned multi-cloud compliance modules covering 1,000+ resource checks for enterprise customers in finance, healthcare, and government at Turbot HQ, cutting compliance-audit time 50%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework to power the backend of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven integration pipeline for Turbot Guardrails, where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a resource; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for manual investigation and debugging.

Built configurable governance workflows extending Guardrails with rule builders, a scoring engine, and approval/prevention policies (branch protection, workflow permissions, runner access, dependency restrictions, MFA, commit-author rules) — the same rule-builder/risk-scoring/approval-workflow pattern TPRM platforms use for vendor assessments and risk scoring.

Authored multi-cloud compliance modules in HCL + SQL covering 1,000+ resource checks across CIS (AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, GitHub), NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4, SOC 2, and FedRAMP frameworks — used by enterprise customers in finance, healthcare, and government — cutting enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via Nunjucks templating automation, keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL.

projects.name: CIS Benchmark → Compliance Dashboard Generator
projects.description: Python CLI that automates compliance-dashboard authoring for a multi-cloud governance product — a reusable technical asset for customer-facing compliance reporting. Ingests CIS benchmark XLSX workbooks (AWS, Azure) and emits ready-to-deploy HCL dashboard config plus markdown docs. OOP resource model, custom HCL pretty-printer, openpyxl + pandas, distributed as a pip-installable package.
